pages.en:
——It is crumbling.

The collapse is now inevitable.

The Einzberns' thousand-year search.

The Makiri's five-hundred-year dearest wish.

An entire world, continued without end, without retreat, and without fulfillment, is about to end here.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Everything’s falling apart.
The collapse is definitive.
The search that took the Einzbern a thousand years.
The earnest desire that took the Makiri five hundred years.
The continuous world that was never completed is about to end.

pages.en:
The old mage, reduced to a mass of flesh, will suffer here until he expires.

He will rot to the end and perish with his longing unfulfilled.

Before his very eyes——

he gazes up at the incarnation of eternity he sought for so long, the thing that had stood only one final step beyond his grasp.

五百年。
五百年に渡り苦しみ続けた成果、与えられてしかるべき報酬が目前にあって、何故消えねばならぬのか。

He does not want to die.

How could he allow himself simply to disappear?

Five hundred years.

The fruits of five hundred years of suffering—the reward he deserves—stand before him. Why must he vanish now?

The doom of the Makiri.

A distinguished line of magi, driven from its homeland to wash ashore in this Far Eastern land, unable to assimilate into its foreign laws, and dwindling into decline.

——But that is wrong.

Had that been the truth, there would still have been salvation.

Had the bloodline ended for such a reason, perhaps he could have accepted extinction in silence.

pages.en:
Three hundred years had passed since the seeker who founded the Makiri.

Three hundred years was the limit of their lineage as magi.

The magi called Makiri had already entered decline by Zouken's generation.

His suffering began there, and the old man could do nothing but deny it.

He was shown that this was as far as the Makiri bloodline would ever reach——and the life of the man called Zouken Matou was his desperate struggle to overturn that verdict.

pages.en:
“Oh, oh, OOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOH……!!!!”

Yes, I cannot die. I curse this collapsing body. It hurts. It hurts. Nothing but pain. Five hundred years of nothing but pain. A life of nothing but pain. Why should I not seek eternity after that? I suffered, I suffered, suffered without fulfillment. How could I disappear without leaving anything behind? How could I die still suffering? The Holy Grail is open before me. Then hear my wish. Ask and I will answer. My wish is I DO NOT WANT TO DIE. If I reach it, if I climb that cliff, my wish will be granted. It will be granted, yet this body cannot reach it. Such a tiny distance, less than dust beside these five hundred years. Why—why is that tiny distance so impossibly far————————!!!!

A thought transformed into a monster of obsession alone.

Deaf to the sound of collapse, seeing nothing but the Holy Grail, it advances.

Then someone addresses that hideous thing no longer of this world——

“——So this is what you have become, Makiri.”

——in a voice as beautiful as a silver bell.

pages.mirrorMoon:
Yes. In the beginning, he had a supreme goal.
To obtain all creation.
To obtain all knowledge.
To reach where no man can reach.
To exceed the limits of the body and reach the infinity we call the soul.

pages.ja:
人間という種。
あらかじめ限界を定められ、脳髄という螺旋の中で回り続けるモノを、外へ。
あらゆる憎悪、あらゆる苦しみを、全て癒し消し去る為に。
pages.jaRuby:
人間という種。
あらかじめ限界を定められ、脳髄という螺旋の中で回り続けるモノを、外へ。
あらゆる憎悪、あらゆる苦しみを、全て癒し消し去る為に。
pages.en:
The species called humanity.

To carry outside that which was bound by predetermined limits, turning forever within the spiral of the brain.

To heal and erase every hatred, every suffering.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The species called humanity has set limits.
To go outside the spiral of the brain.
To eliminate and cure all hatred and suffering.

pages.ja:
思い出す。
楽園などないと知った悲嘆のあと。
この世に無いのならば、肉の身では作る事さえ許されぬのなら、許される場所へ旅立とうと奮い立った。
新しい世界を作るのではなく、自身を、人という命を新しいものに変えるのだと。
pages.jaRuby:
思い出す。
楽園などないと知った悲嘆のあと。
この世に無いのならば、肉の身では作る事さえ許されぬのなら、許される場所へ旅立とうと奮い立った。
新しい世界を作るのではなく、自身を、人という命を新しいものに変えるのだと。
pages.en:
——He remembers.

After the despair of learning that paradise did not exist——

if it was nowhere in this world, if flesh could not be permitted even to create it, then he would set out for a place where it was possible.

They would not create a new world. They would transform themselves—transform human life into something new.
pages.mirrorMoon:
He remembers.
The grief of finding out there’s no such thing as paradise.
If it doesn’t exist in this world, if its creation is impossible with a human body, he inspired himself to go to a place where it can be done.
Not to make a new world, but to change his human life.

pages.ja:
「お
、お」
……そうだ。
見上げるばかりの宙へ、その果てへ、
新しく生まれ変わり、何人も想像できない地平、
我々では思い描けない理想郷に到達する。
pages.jaRuby:
「お
、お」
……そうだ。
見上げるばかりの[ruby text=ソラ]宙へ、その果てへ、
新しく生まれ変わり、[ruby text=なんびと char=2]何人も想像できない地平、
我々では思い描けない理想郷に到達する。
pages.en:
“Oh——oh.”

...Yes.

Toward the heavens he could only gaze upon, and onward to their end——

to be reborn, to reach a horizon no human could imagine,

an ideal land beyond their power even to envision.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“OhOh.”
…That’s right.
To the sky, to the limits.
Be reborn and reach the unimaginable land.
The ideal utopia.

pages.ja:
その為に。
その為に聖杯を求めた。
人の手に余る奇蹟を求めた。
至るまで消える訳にはいかなかった。
幾たび打ちのめされ、何度この身では届かないと悟りながらも、生きている限りは諦められなかった。
pages.jaRuby:
その為に。
その為に聖杯を求めた。
人の手に余る奇蹟を求めた。
至るまで消える訳にはいかなかった。
幾たび打ちのめされ、何度この身では届かないと悟りながらも、生きている限りは諦められなかった。
pages.en:
——For that purpose.

For that purpose, he sought the Holy Grail.

He sought a miracle beyond human hands.

He could not disappear before reaching it.

No matter how many times he was beaten down, no matter how often he realized this body could never attain it, he could not surrender while he remained alive.
pages.mirrorMoon:
It is for that reason.
That’s why he sought the Holy Grail.
He sought a miracle beyond human reach.
He can’t disappear until he makes it reality.
He couldn’t give up, no matter how many times he was beaten, no matter how often he was shown that he could not reach it.

pages.ja:
そう、ユメみたモノはただ一つ。
この世、全ての悪の廃絶の為。
我らは、叶わぬ理想に生命を賭した。
pages.jaRuby:
そう、ユメみたモノはただ一つ。
この世、全ての悪の廃絶の為。
我らは、叶わぬ理想に[ruby text=いのち char=2]生命を賭した。
pages.en:
——Yes. There was only one thing we dreamed of.

For the eradication of all the evil in this world.

We staked our lives upon an impossible ideal.
pages.mirrorMoon:
To eliminate all evils of this world.
They risked their lives for an ideal that couldn’t come true.

pages.ja:
「
お」
だから残った。
あらゆる仇敵たちが去った後も、無意味と知りながらもただ求め続けた。
そう在る事に意味があると信じ、そう在る事が、いつか、自身を継ぐ者を育むのだと知っていた。
pages.jaRuby:
「
お」
だから残った。
あらゆる仇敵たちが去った後も、無意味と知りながらもただ求め続けた。
そう在る事に意味があると信じ、そう在る事が、いつか、自身を継ぐ者を育むのだと知っていた。
pages.en:
“————————Oh.”

That is why he remained.

Even after every adversary had departed, even knowing it was futile, he continued to seek.

He believed that the act itself possessed meaning. He knew that, someday, his persistence would nurture someone to carry on after him.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Oh”
That’s why he remained.
He kept seeking even after his enemies died, knowing it was meaningless.
He believed he had a reason to exist, and that his existence would bring on a successor.

pages.ja:
だから生き続けたのだ。
苦しいと知りながらも死ぬ訳にはいかなかった。
自身を作り変えても、若い頃に見た未熟な悲嘆を覆したかった。
それが自身の生き方であり、己が出した答えではなかったのか。
pages.jaRuby:
だから生き続けたのだ。
苦しいと知りながらも死ぬ訳にはいかなかった。
自身を作り変えても、若い頃に見た未熟な悲嘆を[ruby text=くつがえ]覆したかった。
それが自身の生き方であり、己が出した答えではなかったのか。
pages.en:
That is why he continued to live.

Though he knew only suffering, he could not die.

Even if he had to remake himself, he wanted to overturn the immature despair he had known in his youth.

Was that not the way he had chosen to live—the answer he himself had reached?
pages.mirrorMoon:
That’s why he continued to live.
He can’t die, no matter how much it hurts him.
He wanted to overthrow the youthful anguish he felt when he was young.
That was his way of life: the answer he came up with.

pages.ja:
……そう。
たとえその生に。何の報いが、なかったとしても。
pages.jaRuby:
……そう。
たとえその[ruby text=さき]生に。何の報いが、なかったとしても。
pages.en:
...Yes.

Even if no reward awaited him beyond that life.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…Yes.
Even if his life is not compensated for.

pages.ja:
「お
おお、お…………！」
それが、最初の願いだった。
その苦痛。
叶わぬ望みに挑み続ける事に比べれば、死にたくない、などという望みのなんとちっぽけな事か……！
pages.jaRuby:
「お
おお、お…………！」
それが、最初の願いだった。
その苦痛。
叶わぬ望みに挑み続ける事に比べれば、死にたくない、などという望みのなんとちっぽけな事か……！
pages.en:
“Oh——oh... oh…………!”

That had been his first wish.

That pain.

Compared with continuing to challenge an impossible desire, how pitifully small was the wish not to die...!
pages.mirrorMoon:
“OhOhh, oh……!”
That was his first wish.
The pain.
How small is the wish of not wanting to die, compared to pursuing a wish that will not come true…!?

pages.ja:
「
そうか。そうであったな、ユスティーツァよ」
……世界を見上げる。
大空洞は半ば崩壊していた。
間桐桜は解放され、既にこの世界より連れ出されている。
生み出された、間違いでしかない“第三魔法”は、陽炎のように揺らめいている。
その全てが。
もう、老魔術師には届かない出来事だと受け入れた。
pages.jaRuby:
「
そうか。そうであったな、ユスティーツァよ」
……世界を見上げる。
大空洞は半ば崩壊していた。
間桐桜は解放され、既にこの世界より連れ出されている。
生み出された、間違いでしかない“[ruby text=アンリマユ char=4]第三魔法”は、陽炎のように揺らめいている。
その全てが。
もう、老魔術師には届かない出来事だと受け入れた。
pages.en:
“——I see. So that was it, Justeaze.”

...He looks up at the world.

Half the Greater Cavern has collapsed.

Sakura Matou has been freed and already carried away from this world.

The malformed “Third Magic” that was brought forth—Angra Mainyu—wavers like a heat haze.

——All of it.

He accepts that these events have passed beyond the old mage's reach.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I see. You’re right, Justeaze.”
…He looks up at the world.
The cavern’s collapsing.
Matou Sakura has been released and taken out of this small world.
The Third Sorcery that was created by mistake, Angra Mainyu, is flickering like a heat haze.
And…
The old magus accepts that everything is out of his reach.

pages.ja:
「終わりか。
我が宿願も、我が苦痛も、マキリの使命も
こんなところで、終わるのだな」
それは初めから決まっていたこと。
マキリの旅は、何処で果てようと、所詮はこんなところ止まりである。
pages.jaRuby:
「終わりか。
我が宿願も、我が苦痛も、マキリの使命も
こんなところで、終わるのだな」
それは初めから決まっていたこと。
マキリの旅は、何処で果てようと、所詮はこんなところ止まりである。
pages.en:
“So it ends.

“My dearest wish, my suffering, the Makiri mission——all of it ends in a place such as this.”

It was decided from the beginning.

Wherever the Makiri journey might end, this was ultimately as far as it could ever go.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“So this is it.
My desire, my pain, Makiri’s missioneverything ends here.”
This end was determined at the start.
This is all that Makiri’s journey can accomplish, no matter where it ends.

pages.ja:
「は
はは、ははは」
だが。
それは長い苦痛の果ての、惨めな終焉などでは断じてない。
pages.jaRuby:
「は
はは、ははは」
だが。
それは長い苦痛の果ての、惨めな終焉などでは断じてない。
pages.en:
“Ha——haha. Hahahaha.”

But——

this is by no means a wretched conclusion awaiting him at the end of long suffering.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“HaHaha, hahaha.”
But.
In no way is it a miserable end to a life filled with pain.

pages.ja:
きっと、まだ始まったばかりなのだ。
彼らの試み、その旅は始まったばかり。
五百年など取るに足らぬ。
たったそれだけの年月でどうして届こうか。
我らが望んだものは遥かに眩く尊く、遠く必ず果たされるもの。
これより幾星霜の時間を超え、千の年月、万の年月の末に手に入れる、人間という種の成長だ。
pages.jaRuby:
きっと、まだ始まったばかりなのだ。
彼らの試み、その旅は始まったばかり。
五百年など取るに足らぬ。
たったそれだけの年月でどうして届こうか。
我らが望んだものは遥かに眩く尊く、遠く必ず果たされるもの。
これより幾星霜の[ruby text=とき o2o=1]時間を超え、千の年月、万の年月の末に手に入れる、人間という種の成長だ。
pages.en:
Surely it has only just begun.

Their undertaking—their journey—has only begun.

Five hundred years is nothing.

How could they have reached it in so brief a span?

What they sought is far more radiant, more precious, more distant—and destined to be achieved.

Across the ages yet to come, after a thousand years, after ten thousand: the maturation of the species called humanity.
pages.mirrorMoon:
It’s probably just a start.
His journey is just starting.
Five hundred years is nothing.
How can it be reached in a mere five hundred years?
What they wished for is distant, dazzling, sacred… something that will come true in the distant future.
A growth of the human species that will come after many years, thousands of years, tens of thousands of years.

pages.ja:
ならば、このような瑣末事など始まる為のちっぽけな、けれど必ず意味がある要素にすぎない。
彼らの宿願は、これで終わるのではない。
旅はここから始まる。
ここから、ずっとずっと
また長い長い、遥か彼方を目指す歴史が、ユメの終わりと共に回っていく。
pages.jaRuby:
ならば、このような瑣末事など始まる為のちっぽけな、けれど必ず意味がある要素にすぎない。
彼らの宿願は、これで終わるのではない。
旅はここから始まる。
ここから、ずっとずっと
また長い長い、遥か彼方を目指す歴史が、ユメの終わりと共に回っていく。
pages.en:
Then a trivial matter such as this is merely one small element in that beginning—small, but certain to possess meaning.

Their dearest wish does not end here.

The journey begins here.

From this point, ever onward——a long, long history reaching toward the farthest distance begins to turn as the dream comes to an end.
pages.mirrorMoon:
So this is a trifling, but meaningful matter to start the journey.
It’s not that their desire ends here.
The journey starts here.
The history to reach the distance starts its loop with an end of a dream.

pages.ja:
「
だが無念よ。いや、あと一歩だったのだがなあ」
諦める言葉は、やはり老魔術師そのものだ。
どのような光を目指そうと、彼は悪行を良しとした外道である。
それを最期まで覆さず、彼は生への執着を断った。
pages.jaRuby:
「
だが無念よ。いや、あと一歩だったのだがなあ」
諦める言葉は、やはり老魔術師そのものだ。
どのような光を目指そうと、彼は悪行を良しとした外道である。
それを最期まで覆さず、彼は生への執着を断った。
pages.en:
“——Still, what a shame. I was only one step away.”

Even his words of surrender are unmistakably those of the old mage.

Whatever light he pursued, he was a heretic who embraced atrocity.

He does not recant it even at the end. And so, at last, he relinquishes his attachment to life.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“But how disappointing. My, I was almost there.”
The voice is that of the old magus.
No matter what light he sought, he’s a heretic who approved of wrongdoing.
Not hiding it until the very end, he cuts his attachment to life.

pages.ja:
最後の一人が消える。
奇蹟を求めた魔術師たちの一角、生きながらえ当事者であり続けた傍観者が崩れていく。
pages.jaRuby:
最後の一人が消える。
奇蹟を求めた魔術師たちの一角、生きながらえ当事者であり続けた傍観者が崩れていく。
pages.en:
——The last one disappears.

One corner of the circle of magi who sought the miracle—the observer who survived and remained a party to it—crumbles away.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The last one disappears.
One of the magi that sought a miracle, the observer that also started everything, rots away.

pages.ja:
「五百余年
ク。思えば、瞬きほどの宿願であった」
肉塊は跡形もなく、崩れ落ちた天蓋に呑み込まれた。
pages.jaRuby:
「五百余年
ク。思えば、瞬きほどの宿願であった」
肉塊は跡形もなく、崩れ落ちた天蓋に呑み込まれた。
pages.en:
“More than five hundred years——Hah. Looking back, it was a dearest wish no longer than the blink of an eye.”

The mass of flesh vanishes without a trace beneath the collapsing vault.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Five hundred yearshah. Come to think of it, it was a desire that only lasted for an instant.”
The pile of flesh is buried without trace by the crumbling rocks.

pages.ja:
変貌しながら生き続けたモノ。
魔術師は目指し続けた悲願の崩壊と共に、この世から完全に消滅した。
pages.jaRuby:
変貌しながら生き続けたモノ。
魔術師は目指し続けた悲願の崩壊と共に、この世から完全に消滅した。
pages.en:
The thing that lived on by transforming itself——

together with the collapse of the dearest wish he never ceased pursuing, the mage disappears completely from this world.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The one that lived on, taking many forms.
Every last trace of the magus vanishes from the world, as the embodiment of his desire is destroyed.
